about: The reviewed Content-Security-Policy and Permissions-Policy, as one value each.
One table for both services that send them: the gateway (middleware/security.rs,
strict_csp_is_the_reviewed_policy and headers_match_the_shared_table) and the bridge
Through the gateway the bridge's headers are replaced by the gateway's; the standalone
bridge (no gateway) sends its own, so the two must not drift apart.
tests/e2e/conftest.py reads the policy too: on the candidate gate
(SIGRIFT_E2E_CSP=reviewed) every document must carry exactly this value.
Scripts load only from the origin: no 'unsafe-inline', no 'unsafe-hashes', no
'unsafe-eval', no host sources. Styles keep 'unsafe-inline' until the template
style attributes are moved to stylesheets. Change the value here, in the gateway's
EXPECTED_CSP and in the CHANGELOG together.
content-security-policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https://*.tile.openstreetmap.org; connect-src 'self' wss: ws:; font-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'
